**Standards: PASS.** The standalone caller keeps research bounded to pinned brief/source text and treats it as data (`tools/researcher-task.mjs:35–40, 87`). Grant, route, budget, and source pins are checked before claims or calls (`:18–44`); the SDK uses read-only auth and disables model-network refresh (`:47–57`). The role links to the existing research guide rather than expanding the installed bundle (`.agents/roles/researcher.md:5`).

**Spec: PASS.** Explicit real mode and provider permission are required; fixture mode cannot be selected through the CLI (`tools/researcher-task.mjs:61–65, 105–110`). Retry/fallback is restricted to budgeted 503s after the stream ends; 429 and unknown outcomes block (`:90–99`). Operator quota evidence is explicitly external—not SDK classification—and the routing guide says so (`docs/model-routing.md:38–42`). Worker routing remains unchanged (`:21`).

**Maintainability: PASS.** The scope is a standalone caller, role pointer, and existing-guide addition; I found no material domain-boundary or unused-policy blocker. The test artifact reports injected-SDK controls and an installed-SDK no-provider/auth check, with zero observed network attempts and zero real runtime calls (`.audit/fallback-66-parent-v5.json`). This is not proof of live route availability or fallback integration; the docs correctly make no such claim (`docs/model-routing.md:42`).

**No material blockers found.** Read-only review only; no edits or probes were performed.
